Handmade with care, this ceramic mug is made to be part of your daily routine. Every piece is crafted by hand, so small variations make each one a little different from the next. It's a cozy companion for your morning coffee, an afternoon tea, or a quiet moment to yourself, and it makes a thoughtful gift for someone special (or for yourself).

Cleanup is easy: this mug is dishwasher safe. Please note that it is not microwave safe, so heat your drink separately before pouring it in.
